method.blind: Apply the pinned two-output separator to the first and last four seconds of the same submitted samples. Match stream assignment by absolute centered correlation across the two-second overlap and require at least .25 on both streams. Align polarity and linearly crossfade the overlap. A stream is eligible if its whole-output RMS is at least 8 percent of original RMS, followed by the same speech admission. Take the strongest supported anonymous stream at each window. No truth enters routing or scoring.
method.dense_compute: One unchanged four-second forward at starts 0 and 2 s supplies affine native frame logits. Take the median of the frames with centers inside each one-second interval. Where both contexts contain that interval, take the lower median. Use the same waveform admission rule. The encoder still sees up to four seconds. This is a distinct change in readout and geometry.
method.exact_foreground: Benchmark-only. Score the exact retained pre-mix foreground. A silent foreground in a room-only control is deliberately unassessed. This is a diagnostic comparison, not an upper bound on all detectors.
method.gate: Blind must add at least two useful held edits across at least two generator families at no more than one additional ordinary group versus the fixed stock comparator, without losing any existing useful location or flagging an isolated room. Exact foreground and ideal-mask results can never enter serving.
method.geometry: Compare the two original 2.0 s intervals at 1 and 3 s and a 1.0 s grid every 0.5 s. The short range is a source interval, not an attribution of classifier internals. Both use the unchanged half-window speech-admission rule and checkpoint preprocessing. Preserve all failed or skipped windows.
method.ideal_mask: Benchmark-only. Use the known isolated foreground and background to estimate a squared ideal-ratio mask in a 512-sample Hann STFT at 128-sample hops. Multiply the mixture spectrum by the mask and retain the mixture phase. Reconstruct and round native PCM; this comparison cannot run on an ordinary upload.
method.mixture: Unchanged submitted samples. Reproduce the earlier stock-window measurement and fixed point separately.
method.points: Choose the maximum assessed genuine development score separately for each view and grid, and flag strictly above. Compare each fixed point and a retrospective equal-false-group ranking. Count known impossible geometry, unassessed geometry and best supported overlap before the point.
method.source: Use the retained 52-view three-generator -5 dB comparison as the held panel. Fit points from two distinct retained splice panels (40 files, of which 28 genuine, including four isolated captures). Their rooms and exact foreground identities are disjoint from held. No held labels or scores set a point. All panels had earlier project exposure.
